def check_perm(perm):
    # perm is a tuple/list of 10 elements
    if perm[0] != 0:
        return False
    if perm[3] != 8:
        return False
    if abs(perm[1] - perm[0]) != 8:
        return False
    # check differences are a permutation of 1..9
    diffs = [abs(perm[i] - perm[i-1]) for i in range(1, 10)]
    if sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, 10)):
        return True
    return False
